android.changelog:
Removed the embedded GitHub token that made the system security scanner reject the build as malicious.
- The APK no longer contains any GitHub token or Authorization header. The token was embedded by mistake and made Huawei and Play Protect flag the app as harmful, so installation failed.
- Credentials must never be compiled into the APK. The build now fails outright if a token is passed.
- Update install no longer breaks: single download session, .part file, verification before moving into place, no retry loop on verifier rejection.
